o1: Enables GTPase activator activity. Involved in asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; cortical actin cytoskeleton organization; regulation of actin filament-based process; and regulation of the actomyosin cytoskeleton. Interacts with RHO-1. Is expressed in the early embryo and germ line. RGA-4 exacerbates the gonadal defect phenotype in let-502(sb106) mutants. Orthologous to human ARHGAP11A (Rho GTPase activating protein 11A).
